prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助开发者根据 API 错误码定位问题，并查阅原因和解决办法。","reading":"读者通常先扫描错误码或错误信息定位一行，再横向阅读含义和解决办法；各行需要保持清晰，方便比较相近错误。","groups":["错误码和错误信息共同标识问题，宜靠近并保持标识符完整。","含义和解决办法共同构成排查说明；两列都是自然语言，但解决办法更长，应获得更多宽度。"],"keep_intact":["错误码及英文错误信息标识符，如 INVALID_CREDENTIAL。","说明中的 AppID、access_token、AppSecret、OpenID 和 OAuth2 等技术词汇宜尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["含义和解决办法中的中文说明可按语义自然换行。","较短单元格可利用同一行由长解决办法形成的高度容纳换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [70, 175, 135, 285] · table 666×1384px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 176, 199, 199, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 306px
Design r2B: widths [70, 175, 114, 280] · table 640×1454px · row heights [36, 222, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 1 · OVERFLOWS the box by 280px
Design r2C: widths [70, 175, 155, 300] · table 701×1337px · row heights [36, 176, 199, 176, 176, 199, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 341px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"错误码和错误信息完整且易于扫描；含义列的技术词汇没有被拆开，解决办法获得较多宽度。","problems":"首屏只能看到部分含义，看不到解决办法；部分行较高，短单元格留下较多空白。","cause":"前两列合计245px，含义列又占135px，使解决办法从视口之外开始；285px的解决办法列仍需多行排版。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"前两列完整，横向溢出在三个方案中最少，含义列的右边界接近首屏边缘。","problems":"access_token被拆开，含义列显得拥挤；第一行尤其高，整体纵向浏览负担较大。解决办法仍须横向滚动才能阅读。","cause":"含义列宽114px，扣除内边距和边框后仅余93px，不足以容纳95px的最长不可拆分词；280px的解决办法列也使长说明形成较多行。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"标识符和技术词汇完整；较宽的两列说明改善换行，表格也比其他方案短，行内阅读节奏更舒展。","problems":"首屏仍看不到完整含义和解决办法；横向滚动距离最大，部分较短含义下方留白明显。","cause":"含义列155px、解决办法列300px共同扩大了总宽度；行高由较长的解决办法决定。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[70,175,130,300],"change":"以r2A为基础，将含义列略收至130px，把空间更多分给解决办法；保留技术词所需宽度，尝试降低长行高度。"},{"name":"compact-scroll","widths":[70,175,120,270],"change":"含义列保留99px文本宽度，略高于最长技术词的95px；缩短横向滚动距离，同时观察更窄的解决办法对行高的影响。"},{"name":"wide-solution","widths":[70,175,135,330],"change":"保持r2A的含义列，进一步加宽解决办法，探索以更长横向滚动换取更短、更易比较的行。"}]}
